## 📋 Merge Request / Pull Request

### 🔍 Summary & Context
<!-- Describe what this change does and why it is needed. -->

### 🛠️ Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 `feat`: New feature (e.g. new EPUB parser, audio format export, UI control)
- [ ] 🐛 `fix`: Bug fix (e.g. anti-truncation fix, punctuation handling, model parameter adjustment)
- [ ] ⚡ `perf`: Performance enhancement (e.g. batching, multi-worker caching)
- [ ] ♻️ `refactor`: Code refactoring with no functional change
- [ ] 📝 `docs`: Documentation updates or additions
- [ ] 🧪 `test`: Adding or updating test cases
- [ ] 🔧 `ci`: CI/CD workflow, linter, or build updates

### 🧪 Verification & Evidence
<!-- List the tests or commands run to verify this PR. -->
- **Test Command**: `pytest -v tests/`
- **Output / Evidence**:
  ```text
  All tests passed successfully.
  ```

### 📋 Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this repository.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly.
- [ ] Audio outputs and model weights are excluded by `.gitignore`.
